raw_text: Anti-Agnipath protests turned violent across Bihar and Uttar Pradesh with railway property worth crores damaged. NDTV has confirmed arson at multiple railway stations including Patna Junction, Danapur, Ara, and Buxar. Trains were torched on the Patna-Gaya section. Protest coordination was detected on social media platforms hours before the violence erupted, with Telegram messages calling for coordinated rail blockades.
clean_text: Anti-Agnipath protests caused railway property damage worth crores across Bihar and UP. Arson at multiple stations and trains torched. Social media coordination detected hours before violence.
